summary: Interfaces with Elgato Stream Decks via WebHID in a popup window to bypass iframe restriction constraints in Cables editor.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Activates the driver and opens the external WebHID helper window.

ports.name: Open Popup
ports.text: Triggers or focuses the popup window for WebHID device permission request.

ports.name: Device Index
ports.text: Selects which connected device to control.

ports.name: Connection
ports.text: Outputs the connection object needed by texture streaming operators.

ports.name: Is Connected
ports.text: Outputs true when a Stream Deck device is connected inside the popup.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: String output showing connection details and state.

ports.name: Window Status
ports.text: Status of the popup window (Open, Closed, Blocked).

ports.name: Device Info
ports.text: Returns metadata (name, key count, grid dimensions) of the connected device.

ports.name: Key Event
ports.text: Trigger fired whenever a button is pressed or released on the Stream Deck.

ports.name: Event Key Index
ports.text: The index of the button (0-indexed) associated with the event.

ports.name: Event Pressed
ports.text: True if pressed, false if released.
